evidence: Modifies src/bitcoin-tx.cpp, src/bitcoin-util.cpp, and src/bitcoin-wallet.cpp to enable hardware SHA256 detection.
rationale: Enables hardware SHA256 acceleration in standalone CLI utilities, addressing a performance regression where tools defaulted to generic SHA256. Commit 02a7f11038 reports that 'On an M2 Max, grind is ~5x faster and signing 2000 P2PKH inputs with bitcoin-tx ~2.3x.'
